explanationMd: Write one as (x + 1)/(x + 1). Subtracting two in the numerator gives (x + 1 − 2)/(x + 1) = (x − 1)/(x + 1). The original excluded input remains excluded.

distractorRationale.c: This does not put the terms over a common denominator.
distractorRationale.a: This subtracts numerators without representing one correctly.
distractorRationale.e: One must be written as (x + 1)/(x + 1), not x/(x + 1).
